newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Canberra names BTR for helicopter upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Canberra names BTR for helicopter upgrade.

text.p: The Australian government on Thursday named BTR Plc unit Hawker de Havilland Victoria Ltd as the preferred tenderer to upgrade the Australian navy's 16 Seahawk helicopters.
Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said Hawker de Havilland had been selected to acquire and integrate forward looking infrared, electronic support and countermeasures equipment for the helicopters.

"The Hawker de Havilland proposal offers the best all round value for providing a sensor suite to enhance the protection and combat effectiveness of the Seahawk helicopters, which operate from the six Royal Australian Navy Adelaide Class frigates," McLachlan said in a statement.
The Defence Department declined to say how much the upgrade would cost but one government official said the contract was "in the millions".
The new equipment, to be operational in the helicopters by 2002, would improve the ability to identify potential threats.

"The same equipment will be used where feasible for both the existing Seahawks and the new Super Seasprite helicopters, which are planned to be acquired from Kaman Aerospace of the United States," McLachlan said.
